propositions: A live four-patchset Gerrit dogfood probe must validate that the deployed review bot correctly loads and executes the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion end-to-end through the four-pass pipeline, only when the seam repair and project criterion are landed.

The positive-control patchset (PS1) must emit no project-attributed finding because its valid discovery/evidence refinement does not cross phase boundaries, confirming the criterion executes correctly on valid input.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset (PS3) must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], validity=1.0, impact=0.36, priority=0.36, decision=advisory, block_threshold=0.90, and blocking_enabled=false, proving deployed execution.

The cleaned final patchset (PS4) removing the FIRE directive must produce no project-attributed findings and must be the only revision submitted to main, with blocking remaining disabled and threshold at 0.90.
Blocking promotion to enabled must be deferred to a future separately-reviewed, data-backed posture ticket; this dogfood is observational only and does not enable blocking or tune the rubric.
The entire probe must maintain blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 throughout, with all findings and Pass-2/Pass-3 attributes recorded as observational data from live bot execution.
